audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers award Ziggs all seven phases at 7/10 while the prose itself concedes Aatrox's healing and gap-close from level 3.
audit.why: The mirror audit (audits/top/aatrox__ziggs.json) already settled this chart: Level 1 Ziggs, Level 2 even, Levels 3 through First item Aatrox, Two+ items even. Restating it from Ziggs' side keeps the two pages from rendering opposite answers.
audit.corrected: phases[1]/win[1] even, phases[2..5]/win[2..5] Aatrox, phases[6]/win[6] even, with ratings inverted to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: First-item spike text names Luden's/Liandry's while every other field on the page builds Blackfire Torch, and no spike accounts for Aatrox's healing outscaling the chip.
audit.why: Deathbringer Stance (P) and Umbral Dash (E) both heal, and World Ender (R, 120/100/80s) increases healing — a first-item burst spike that ignores Grievous Wounds overstates the window.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text rebuilt around Blackfire Torch plus an anti-heal buy; Mega Inferno Bomb name confirmed correct (packet suspectName is a false positive).

audit.whatIsWrong: The page claims Aatrox has no gap-closer at level 2 and never states the two interactions that decide the lane: his healing versus your chip, and his auto-reset opener.
audit.why: Umbral Dash (E) is a dash on 9/8/7/6/5s available from level 2 and passively heals on champion damage; Deathbringer Stance (P) is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up — not a cast — is the tell. Your E minefield is a 16s flat cooldown with reduced damage on repeat detonations against the same target, so it cannot chip him down through that sustain alone.
audit.corrected: whys[1..6] and phases[1..6].why rewritten around the 9s-to-5s Umbral Dash, the 8s Q cooldown at 4-5, the healing, and the anti-heal requirement; dontsFull[2].d now carries the Deathbringer Stance auto-reset tell.

audit.why: W Satchel at 20/18/16/14/12s is correctly framed as the one button that must be held for his commit.

edits.before: At level 2 he still has no gap-closer, so you chunk him every time his Q is down.
edits.after: Umbral Dash is up at 2 on a 9s cooldown, so trade only while that dash is down.

edits.before: Level 3 gives you full Q-W-E zoning that keeps him out of sweet-spot range.
edits.after: Level 3 he has the full Q chain plus a healing dash into your 16s minefield.

edits.before: Through 4-5 your poke outpaces his passive healing whenever his Q is on cooldown.
edits.after: By 4-5 his Q drops toward 8s and Deathbringer Stance heals your chip damage back.

edits.before: Your level 6 Mega Inferno Bomb answers his all-in and punishes E commits.
edits.after: World Ender's healing outlasts one Mega Inferno Bomb — never duel him at 6.

edits.before: First item turns Bouncing Bomb into burst that outdamages his sustain.
edits.after: Without anti-heal his first-item sustain outlasts your Bouncing Bomb burst.

edits.before: You scale into an unkillable artillery threat that zones him off every fight.
edits.after: Two items in, your artillery zoning trades evenly with his drain-tank all-in.

edits.before: W Satchel online — your disengage button. You can now take a greedy trade and blast yourself out of the answer.
edits.after: W Satchel online — your disengage button. His Umbral Dash can be up too, so the greedy trade cuts both ways.

edits.before: Full kit: E minefield behind you makes you nearly unchaseable. Bounce Q off the wave so Aatrox can't read the angle.
edits.after: His full Q chain plus a 7s Umbral Dash beats your 16s minefield — bounce Q off the wave and hold W for his step-up.

edits.before: Stack Manaflow and chip Aatrox below 60% — that's the zone where R + jungle help executes. Track World Ender before every step-up.
edits.after: His Q falls toward 8s and Deathbringer Stance heals your chip back — stack Manaflow, farm at range, and fight only with jungle help.

edits.before: Mega Inferno Bomb online — any chipped target or crashing wave is now your gold. Hold it for the sub-60% HP window.
edits.after: World Ender turns his healing on for a long window — Mega Inferno Bomb is escape damage here, not a duel opener. Hold W too.

edits.before: Blackfire Torch spike — your Q chunks become unhealable burn chip. Aatrox now chooses between farm and HP every wave.
edits.after: Blackfire Torch chips him, but without Grievous Wounds his first-item sustain refills it — buy anti-heal before you contest him.

edits.before: Shadowflame + Torch makes the full rotation lethal, but the map matters more — rotate R to sieges and skirmishes.
edits.after: Shadowflame + Torch makes your rotation lethal and he cannot reach you — rotate R to sieges instead of dueling him.

edits.before: Luden's/Liandry's turns your Bouncing Bomb into real burst — a full Q+E rotation shreds a chunk of his health bar before he lands a single Q sweet spot.
edits.after: Blackfire Torch turns Bouncing Bomb into real burst, but Deathbringer Stance heals off your max health — buy Grievous Wounds or the chip just refills.

edits.before: His drain-tank mode — never take a long fight into it. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Short Fuse plus an 850-range Q chips him on every last-hit — step back before his Umbral Dash closes the gap.

edits.before: Burning W Satchel for damage and then standing in World Ender range with no escape — the only way this lane kills you.
edits.after: No dash means fog is fatal — his combo opens with a Deathbringer Stance auto reset, so the wind-up is your cue to already be gone.

notes: packet suspectNames flagged "Your Mega Inferno Bomb" in spikes[1].text — FALSE POSITIVE, that is Ziggs' real R name; left alone. The kit file lists Aatrox Q/E/R range as 25000 (Riot placeholder), so no range numbers were quoted for those. Level chart proposed as one atomic group in matched full/content pairs; even phases use the "Skill" token per the mirror's read that Level 2 and Two+ items are even.
